subject: Post-demo: hosting preference + migration orchestration for AtlasHealth
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <srao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + clarifying hosting/migration asks

Hi Samir — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and the three things we need to confirm to move to a scoped PoC:

1) Hosting preference: you mentioned AtlasHealth prefers predictable performance for inference but needs PHI isolation. My understanding: short-term pilot on Redwood Hosted API to move fast, with roadmapped move to Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) + Private VPC for PHI production. Please confirm which of the two approaches you want scoped for the PoC (Hosted pilot only vs Hosted -> Dedicated transition vs Direct Dedicated/Private POC).

2) Migration sources: you said you have two existing runtimes — (a) an OpenAI-based integration used by product features and (b) an internal legacy GPU cluster (NVIDIA A100 cluster running custom tokenizers and weights). We need to confirm whether you expect Redwood to accept BYO model weights for the Dedicated/Private deployment, and whether there are any nonstandard tokenizers we should know about.

3) Timeline & target QPS: please confirm expected peak QPS and SLOs for the pilot (p50/p95 latency targets). That determines whether we recommend Dedicated capacity from day 1 or a Hosted pilot with aggressive batching/caching rules.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft MAP), Redwood_Dedicated_Overview.pdf (high-level architecture and SLAs).

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm hosting preference and provide security contact + procurement contact (we'll add a brief security questionnaire).
- Monica will draft a migration runbook and cost estimate once we know QPS and expected model formats.
- Schedule a 30-min procurement/ops kickoff next week to align on PO and DPA.

If the team prefers, we can also scope a short Dedicated-only 1-week soak test (reserve capacity) to validate latency for PHI-sensitive flows.

Thanks — I can update the mutual action plan after you confirm.

—
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Rao <srao@atlashealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + clarifying hosting/migration asks

Thanks Lauren — recap looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Hosting preference: we'd like to start with Hosted API for speed (a 2–3 week pilot) to validate integration and basic throughput. Our long-term plan is Dedicated with Private VPC for PHI, but we need to confirm cost/latency delta. Is there a standard uplift to convert a Hosted pilot into Dedicated reserved capacity?

- BYO weights: yes, our ML team wants to move some in-house optimized weights (not open-source checkpoints) into Redwood if possible. Our legal team will want to understand where those binaries live and how they are encrypted at rest.

- Legacy cluster: our on-prem cluster runs custom tokenization and a slightly modified transformer that was compiled against an older CUDA stack. We expect some model conversion work.

- QPS/targets: pilot traffic will be low — roughly 2–4 QPS with bursts to 15 QPS; p95 target ~300ms for short prompts. If Dedicated is needed for consistent p95 sub-200ms, we want to know that number now so procurement can budget.

Looping in procurement (procurement@atlashealth.com) and Alex (platform lead). Please confirm: 1) whether Redwood Hosted can be used during pilot if we plan to bring BYO weights later; 2) any immediate blockers for bridging from our cluster to Redwood.

 — Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Platform | AtlasHealth
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <srao@atlashealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + clarifying hosting/migration asks

On Thu, Aug 12, 2027 at 09:20 AM Samir Rao <srao@atlashealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Lauren — recap looks right. A few clarifications from our side:
> - Hosting preference: we'd like to start with Hosted API for speed (a 2–3 week pilot) to validate integration and basic throughput. Our long-term plan is Dedicated with Private VPC for PHI, but we need to confirm cost/latency delta. Is there a standard uplift to convert a Hosted pilot into Dedicated reserved capacity?

Hi Samir — quick technical responses:  
1) Hosted vs BYO weights: Redwood Hosted API cannot accept private model binaries for multi-tenant hosted endpoints. For BYO weights we offer two paths: Dedicated (we can provision a reserved GPU pool and deploy your weights) or Private (VPC/on-prem package where weights stay in your VPC). For the pilot you can use Hosted with an open checkpoint (or a redwood-verified model) to validate integration, then transition to Dedicated/Private for BYO weights.

2) Conversion from legacy cluster: we commonly do model conversion (convert custom checkpoints to a standard format, align tokenizers, and run quantization if needed). Typical conversion time for a bespoke model is 3–10 business days depending on custom ops. We will produce a short migration runbook (draft link below) that lists the artifacts we need (checkpoint, tokenizer files, model config, example inputs).

3) Latency & capacity: given your pilot QPS, Hosted with our caching/batching should meet p95 ~300ms for short prompts. For sustained low-latency under bursty traffic (<200ms p95) Dedicated is usually the recommendation because you get reserved GPU throughput and lower queuing. I'll include a simple capacity estimate in the MAP once you confirm model size and tokenization.

Actionable items from SE:
- We will populate the migration-runbook draft with exact artifacts and a conversion checklist. (Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c)
- I'll attach a model-migration-checklist.pdf to this thread for your ML team to review.
- Lauren will draft the MAP and procurement doc to show Hosted->Dedicated transition costs.

Attachments: model-migration-checklist.pdf

If helpful, we can run a 1-day compatibility exercise where we attempt to load one of your smaller checkpoints into a Dedicated dev pool and report conversion blockers. That usually surfaces any custom ops quickly.

—
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0198

Thanks Samir & team — solid questions. Confirming next steps and owners so we can move the MAP to a committed plan:

1) Pilot scope (owner: Lauren) — Hosted API pilot (2–3 weeks) to validate integration and telemetry. Deliverable: pilot runbook + success criteria (integration, error rate, p95).
2) Compatibility check (owner: Monica) — 1-day compatibility run on a small checkpoint in a Dedicated dev pool. Deliverable: conversion notes and time estimate.
3) Security & contracts (owner: Karthik) — send our short security worksheet and DPA; procurement team to review the Hosted pilot terms and options to convert to Dedicated.

I updated the MAP draft in HubSpot and attached the HubSpot deal here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567. Monica — please drop the migration-runbook link into the MAP and Alex/procurement, Lauren will schedule a 30-min slot next Tue/Thu to align on PO timelines.

Proposed meeting times (PST): Tue Aug 17 10:00-10:30 or Thu Aug 19 15:00-15:30. Samir/Alex/procurement — which slot works?

Thanks, will update mutual_action_plan.xlsx once we confirm time.
